verdict.rationale: Evidence shows refunds are available through Stripe's standard Refunds API/Dashboard (inherited by agent-driven orders) and that the Stripe MCP server explicitly supports refunds as a stripe_api_write action, gated by human approval before an agent can execute or retry it. However, there's no agent-specific refund tracking mechanism (e.g., dedicated refund status webhooks tied to agent_details, or refund reporting in the agent-tagged Transactions view) beyond the standard Stripe rails. Missing for 10: dedicated refund tracking/webhooks scoped to agent orders, explicit API examples for programmatic refund initiation on SPT-based orders, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the refund flow working end-to-end.
